name: Community engagement

subjectOf.text: CRDAO community engagement is the mechanism that minimizes issues of lacking crowd controls, lowers the time requirements and prices of code reviews, increases developer participation, and increases overall feedback.
subjectOf.abstract: The code review process of the CRDAO revolves around CRDAO community engagement which minimizes issues of lack of crowd controls, lowers time requirements for code reviews, lowers prices of code reviews, increases developer participation, and increases overall feedback.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709

subjectOf.text: Fundraiser DAOs are structurally fragile because they typically lack incentives for meaningful community engagement, so they dissipate once the hype that created them fades.
subjectOf.abstract: Fundraiser DAOs are vulnerable in multiple ways. They often lack incentives for meaningful community engagement and tend to dissipate with the hype.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
scope_conditions: DAOs formed primarily to raise funds
